message:
Archive the small-context run measurements (Spark offline; logs at risk)

Everything captured from mav10h.log / mav100h.log over ssh during and
after the runs, consolidated before more is lost: headline numbers for
both runs, the S=10 per-round sweep times against their identity
budgets, verbatim log tails, transcript provenance, and the T_wit
weight-processing-floor finding (R2's 33 min at S=10 as the
diagnostic). Reconstructed values are marked as such; the S=100
per-round confirmation (R2 ~33 min predicted) is flagged as pending
the box's return.
